title: Rust SCHC rule matching accepts values and descriptors outside declared field widths
description: rust/lichen-schc/src/context.rs validates descriptor length_bits only inside the MSB matching branch and does not reject packet field values, target values, or match-mapping entries whose set bits exceed length_bits. MSB(0) succeeds before any value-width check, and Equal, Ignore, and MatchMapping descriptors bypass the stated 1..=128 width restriction. Invalid rules or parsed values may select in Rust, diverge from Python rule_matches, and fail or truncate later during residue encoding.
acceptance_criteria: Add one centralized validation path used before every MO/CDA match. Reject descriptor widths outside 1..=128 and reject present field values, target values when applicable, and every mapping value that is not representable in length_bits. Apply this consistently to Equal, MSB including MSB(0), MatchMapping, and Ignore with all CDAs. Define handling for malformed static/custom rules without panics. Add boundary tests for widths 0, 1, 128, and 129; values and TVs at max, max+1; invalid mapping members; all MO/CDA combinations; and Rust/Python parity. Existing valid MSB prefix cases 0, 1, 127, and 128 must continue to work.
